lines.en: My wings are like obsidian.
I cross the End's open ground.
This silence does not trouble me.
My wingbeats sound hard.
I circle the obsidian pillars.
I am in no hurry to be anywhere.
My wings catch a violet sheen.
I glide slowly toward you.
I do not settle on ordinary leaves.
I pass between the floating islands.
My shadow is like a blade.
I fly in a perfectly straight line.
I need no nectar.
I skim the edge of the void.
My wings do not wear.
I fly through day and night.
I rest on obsidian.
My wing casings are hard.
I never grow old.
My antennae are still.
The End's wind goes around me.

lines.zh: 我这翅膀硬得像黑曜石。
lines.en: These wings are hard as obsidian.
The patterns on my wings run deep.
I am counting the floating islands.
I am as quiet as an object.
The scent of chorus fruit does not move me.
My wings need not close.
How did you get here?
Your skin is far too soft.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一件旧物
lines.en: I regard you like an old object.
You carry the smell of outside.
My eyes do not reflect light.
You stand out here.
I have watched you a long while.
You should not sit on the obsidian.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一合就是一块甲
lines.en: My wings close into armor.
Something on you is ticking.
A white mark on my casing.
No pain; only a sound.
I tilted; my poise held.
Your weapon is not dull.
My wings quivered.
This will heal on its own.
I was pushed half a block.
This will not change my mind.
The End yields no nectar.

lines.zh: 你的东西在末地留不住
lines.en: What you carry will not last here.
I have no use for sweetness.
You hold it up; I do not move.
It matters more to you.
I will not even sniff it.
Carry it out with you.
This place does not lack your morsel.
My wing casings are harder than that.
You hit shell.
Not even my wing tilted.
My wing edges are sharp.
There is already blood on your hand.
Neither of us yielded.
It sounded like striking stone.
No mark on my wings.
Do not fly this close to me.
Get behind the pillar.

lines.zh: 这里空间很大，绕开就行
lines.en: There is plenty of room; go around.
I have lived too long.
That has no meaning for me.
There are no seasons in the End.
I rarely even see my own kind.
I need no second shadow.
You ask too late.
Such things ceased to matter long ago.
I would rather watch the void.
Do not break my quiet.
Leave this island.
I do not grip with claws.

lines.zh: 这片地上掉的东西很少
lines.en: Little falls on this ground.
I touched it with a wing.
It slid off my wing.
This does not belong to the End.
You pick it up.
It looks weightless on the ground.
Carry it out with you.
Things here do not leave easily.
You moved just now.
Nothing has moved here in a long time.
I turn my gaze to you.

lines.zh: 你身上有末地没有的热
lines.en: You carry heat the End does not have.
The End does not welcome guests.
You will not find the way back.
There is no cover here.
Listen; only wind.
I circle above you.
You crossed that bridge.
You cannot jump between the islands.
Your torch is useless here.

lines.zh: 我翅上的紫光一直亮着
lines.en: The violet on my wings stays lit.

lines.zh: 你在末地石上留下脚印
lines.en: You leave prints on the end stone.
I move to your path.
Do you hear the hard wings?
There is no daytime here.
You need not run at all.
My wing edge sweeps past.
This strike is very hard.
You took a cut.
I could put no weight behind it.
My wings are sharper than a blade.
You fell back two steps.
No chip on my casings.
I will fly back again.
I was already on this open ground.

lines.zh: 你从传送门出来时我就在
lines.en: I was here when you came through the portal.
The End has a guest.

lines.zh: 我的翅壳在紫光里发亮
lines.en: My casings shine in the violet light.
I approach in a spiral.
Time barely moves here.
I come from behind an obsidian pillar.
No spawn egg made me.

lines.zh: 这座岛上的东西都认得我
lines.en: Everything on this island knows me.
I settle lightly.
Fire does not last in the End.

lines.zh: 我跌下浮岛，翅膀撑住了
lines.en: I dropped from an island; my wings held.
There is no water here, only void.

lines.zh: 爆炸让我的壳震了一下
lines.en: The blast rattled my casing.
The arrow glanced off my casing.
The spell slid off me.
I neither eat nor drink; I simply do not age.
Lightning is rare in this sky.
The void is taking me back.
